data.title: Perceptron AI Launches Isaac 0.5, a Frontier Open-Weight Robotics Model - AIwire
data.description: Perceptron’s Isaac 0.5 outperforms leading open robot models, including Physical Intelligence’s π0.5 and NVIDIA’s GR00T N1.7 BELLEVUE, Wash., Aug. 31, 2026 — Perceptron AI has launched Isaac 0.5, a 36-billion-parameter open-weight embodied foundation model that combines video understanding, embodied reasoning and robot control, the first open model at the frontier of all three.
